direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale feels very auteur-driven as he builds the world well and incorporates themes of a psychological thriller and the supernatural to make this movie feel like a pseudo-horror movie; The pop star sequences were filmed decently, but they just felt pretty basic; The direction on a microscale is good as the whole movie is really a conversation between two long-lost friends, and their chemistry really makes this movie work; Storytelling is not the best as this movie really drags and takes an unexpected turn that makes the movie feel boring in the second half; Tension is not built well as they try to build the psychological thriller, but at no point was I ever really on edge

performance.comments: The whole movie feels like an career retrospective for her as the movie is about a star who was famous from 2003-2015, lost her spot due to age, and is attempting a comeback in the second act of her career; because of the career writing, the performance feels very personal and you can tell she becomes the character; her chemistry with Coel is good as their relationship is the core of the movie

Strong in her performance and plays off Hathaway very well as she has a certain destain for how the relationship has evolved over the years; has good chemistry with Hathaway as this relationship is the center of the movie; her whispering made it pretty hard to hear what she was saying cause it was poorly mixed into the movie with the score blaring
I wonder if she's seen a movie before?

cast.comments: There really isn't a supporting cast as the movie is really a conversation between 2 long lost friends, who have good chemistry and show why their relationship has soured over the years

story.comments: The concept on the surface is a critique of the modern popstar, but at its core, it is a story between two long-lost friends using a dress as a way to get back into each other's lives; That is only for the first half, because the second half just becomes an unnecessary ghost story that really drags down the movie; The plot structure is a huge issue for this movie because the film really drags, which is attributed to the second half taking a turn and becoming a ghost story; The ending also just feels a bit propped up and filled with fake tension; Character writing is good as you really understand these characters and their relationship together, and Anne Hathaway's character really feels like a reflection of her career as an actress

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is strong and well-written; The humor is decent, and they do an alright job of making it feel entertaining; The symbolism is very strong for this movie as the whole film is a critique of pop stardom and the feeling of always being seen; The movie also feels like a retrospective of Anne Hathaway's career as it alludes to how her peak was from 2003 to 2015, how she has had a career lull since, and how she is looking for a comeback to usher in a new era; The movie also has a lot of subtext on what their relationship really is, as it is alluded that they may have been more than just friends; The foreshadowing is not the best because it basically sets up the ending right away, but it is fine within the context of the movie

score.comments: The score is fine in some moments but feels kind of out of place in others; It also feels pretty poorly mixed in with the audio because it just gets hard to hear what anyone is saying

soundtrack.comments: The opening song was pretty good, but besides that, the rest of the songs really were not that memorable

cinematography.comments: The film is well shot and feels like an extension of the auteurism in helping capture these scenes

editing.comments: There were way too many cuts per scene, especially in the talking scenes, so much so that it got incredibly annoying to watch; I literally kept tapping my thigh every time there was a cut, and it ended up being a whole drumbeat; Also, the weird fading cuts just felt really out of place; The transitions between worlds in the retrospective parts were well done, but not enough to save the cut

sound.comments: The sound was poorly mixed because I could barely hear what anyone was saying since the ADR was basically whispering into the mic; It does not do a good job of building tension

visual_effects.comments: The ghost aspect of this movie looked very tacky, but everything else was fine

production_design.comments: The movie really is just a one-house movie, and the pop stage just felt fine

makeup.comments: The makeup helps paint this character as a pop star

costumes.comments: Costume design is a key element of the storytelling, and the highlight was the dresses in this movie

review.pacing: Pacing is very bad as the movie drags at many moments; They could have cut a good 20 minutes out of this movie, especially the ghost sequence, to make the movie tighter and more interesting
review.climax: The climax just felt artificially propped up and not that satisfying
review.tone: The tone is very psychological thriller, but it shifts to becoming a ghost story in the second half to make the whole movie feel like a pseudo-horror movie
review.overall: Overall, "Mother Mary" excels with its symbolism and chemistry as both synergistically work together to critique the modern popstar; it showcases a celebrity who was famous from 2003 to 2015, has fallen out of relevancy, and is looking for a comeback to usher in a new era, which is a perfect allegory for Anne Hathaway's career; however, it is held back by its editing that does way too much and the fact that it is so incredibly slow in the first half that it feels like a chore to finish this movie
